text.p: Alexandria Spinning and Weaving /Spinalex said on Wednesday it made pre-tax profits of 1.86 million pounds ($550,000) in the first half of financial year 1996/7.
It compared this to pre-tax profits of 8.971 million pounds in the whole of 1995/6, which ended on June 30. Those profits came mainly from exceptional items.
Net after-tax profits in 1995/6 were 7.199 million pounds, against 7.023 million in 1994/5.
In the first half of 1996/7, the July-December period, the company increased sales to 87.140 million pounds, compared with 144.382 million in the whole of 1995/6.
Government newspapers have said the state, which remains the majority shareholder, may soon sell off a further tranche of Spinalex shares to the private sector.
